zh: 柏林自由大学（Freie Universität Berlin，简称FU Berlin）成立于1948年，位于德国柏林市，是德国著名的公立研究型大学。学校在社会科学、自然科学、人文艺术、医学等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居德国前列。柏林自由大学以其优秀的教学质量和自由的学术氛围，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Freie Universität Berlin (FU Berlin), founded in 1948, is a renowned public research university in Berlin, Germany. It excels in social sciences, natural sciences, humanities, medicine, and more, with leading academic research in Germany. Known for its excellent teaching quality and free academic environment, Freie Universität Berlin has produced numerous talents across fields.
